segments: until they can't speak. Verse five.
Uhhuh. They are upright as the palm tree
but speak not. Yo, so the trees, the
well, the moon and so forth, they speak
not. Go ahead. They must stone, the
cobblestone, they don't speak. They
don't move. They can't go nowhere. They
can't help you. Go ahead. They must need
be born. They must need be born. You
have to carry them. How you got to save
your idol that's supposed to protect
you? Go ahead. They must need be born
because they cannot go. They cannot go
on their own. Read. Be not afraid of
them. But they cannot do evil. They
can't do anything to you. Go ahead.
Neither also is it in them to do good.
Right? They can't do evil or they can't
do good because they are nothing. All
right.
